items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: So my father came, and we talked... And he made an attempt at giving me some lessons.

ctx.x: So my father came, and we talked... And he made an attempt at giving me some lessons. He wanted me to play what they called double embrochure at the time, because... In other words, the way I play is like single embrochure, where you put your top teeth on the mouthpiece and your lip over your bottom teeth. But he put his top lip over the top teeth and his bottom lip over the bottom teeth. And they claimed that that way you could play a brass and reed instrument, and it wouldn't split the tone, some kind of way...…
So anyway, we all went down to catch the Silas Green Show every time it came to town.
